total_unique.description: Total unique records matching the query before pagination. Emitted by the fast LERG 6 endpoint and the generic GET query endpoint.

offset.description: Pagination offset used for this response. Emitted by the fast LERG 6 endpoint only.

limit.description: Pagination limit used for this response. Emitted by the fast LERG 6 endpoint only.

data.description: Query results — fields vary by request

joined_with.description: Name of the joined table when a join was applied. Always present on responses from `POST /v1/telique/lerg/query`; `null` when no join was requested.
